_about: PROPOSAL (docs/design/host-effect-policy.md, exo-002.7) — not read by any host yet. Extends access-policy.json from allowed CALLERS to gated EFFECTS: a call to a listed capability must carry an authorization of the declared FORMAT, from a trusted ISSUER, for an executable room intent whose materialization root matches the call, before expiry. The policy names a format and issuers, never a module: muster is one provider of muster.authorization.v1 (today the only one).

muster.authorization.v1.signature: secp256k1 recoverable, 65 bytes, over the digest
